  flxChatUpdates(
    since: $since
    after: $after
    chatId: $chatId
    afterChat: $afterChat
  ) {
    rev
    continueRev
    continueId
    truncated
    messagesTruncated
    unread
    chats {
      ...FlxChatFields
    }
    messages {
      ...FlxChatMessageFields
    }
    incoming {
      databaseId
      chatId
      title
      body
    }
    connections {
      id
      label
      color
      state
    }
  }
}
